    int n, source, sink;
    vector<vector<int>> adj;

    };
    vector<Edge> edges;

    MinCostMaxFlow(int n, int source, int sink): n(n), source(source), sink(sink), adj(n) {}

    int add_edge(int a, int b, int cap, int cost) {
        int id = (int)edges.size();
        adj[a].push_back(id);
        edges.push_back({b, 0, cap, cost, cost});
        adj[b].push_back(id ^ 1);
        edges.push_back({a, 0, 0, -cost, -cost});
        return id;
    }

    pair<int,int> djk() {
        vector<int> dist(n, INT_MAX/2), prev(n, -1), maxf(n, 0);
        priority_queue<pair<int,int>, vector<pair<int,int>>, greater<pair<int,int>>> pq;
        dist[source] = 0;
        prev[source] = -2;
        maxf[source] = INT_MAX;
        pq.push(make_pair(0, source));
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            int d = pq.top().first;
            int v = pq.top().second;
            pq.pop();
            if (d != dist[v]) continue;
            for (int id : adj[v]) {
                Edge &ed = edges[id];
                if (ed.flow < ed.cap && dist[ed.to] > dist[v] + ed.cost) {
                    dist[ed.to] = dist[v] + ed.cost;
                    prev[ed.to] = id;
                    maxf[ed.to] = min(maxf[v], ed.cap - ed.flow);
                    pq.push(make_pair(dist[ed.to], ed.to));
                }
            }

        int last = prev[sink];
        if (last == -1) return make_pair(0, 0);
        int add = maxf[sink];

            edges[id].flow += add;
            edges[id ^ 1].flow -= add;
            costPath += edges[id].orig;
        }
        for (int id = 0; id < (int)edges.size(); ++id) {
            int v = edges[id ^ 1].to;
            int u = edges[id].to;
            if (prev[v] != -1 && prev[u] != -1)
                edges[id].cost += dist[v] - dist[u];
        }
        return make_pair(add, costPath);
    }

    void bellman_ford() {
        vector<int> dist(n, INT_MAX/2);
        dist[source] = 0;
        for (int rep = 0; rep < n; ++rep) {
            bool changed = false;

                    dist[u] > dist[v] + e.cost) {
                    dist[u] = dist[v] + e.cost;
                    change = true;
                    assert(i < N - 1);
                }
            }
            if (!change) break;
        }
        for (auto &e : edges) {
            int v = edges[e.rev].to, u = e.to;
            if (dist[v] < INT_MAX / 2 && dist[u] < INT_MAX / 2)
                e.cost += dist[v] - dist[u];
        }
    }

    pii maxFlowMinCost() {
        int flow = 0, totalCost = 0;
        bool needBF = false;
        for (auto &e : edges)
            if (e.flow > 0 && e.cost < 0) {
                needBF = true;
                break;
            }
        if (needBF) initialBellman();
        while (true) {
            pii res = runDijkstra();
            if (res.first == 0) break;
            flow += res.first;
            totalCost += res.first * res.second;
        }
        return pii(flow, totalCost);
    }
};

const int maxn = 2521;
int nodeId[maxn][maxn];
vector<int> roads[maxn];

        roads[x].push_back(y);

    }
    int cnt = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < T; ++i)
        for (int v = 1; v <= n; ++v)
            nodeId[i][v] = cnt++;
    int src = cnt++, snk = cnt++;
    Network net(cnt, src, snk);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i)
        net.addEdge(src, nodeId[0][pos[i]], 1, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < T; ++i)
        net.addEdge(nodeId[i][1], snk, k, c * i);
    for (int i = 0; i < T - 1; ++i) {
        for (int v = 1; v <= n; ++v) {
            for (int nxt : roads[v]) {
                for (int z = 0; z <= 52; ++z)
                    net.addEdge(nodeId[i][v], nodeId[i + 1][nxt], 1, d * (2 * z + 1));
            }
            net.addEdge(nodeId[i][v], nodeId[i + 1][v], k, 0);
        }
    }
    int f, ans;
    tie(f, ans) = net.maxFlowMinCost();
